stories.h: Lynnwood police seek man who stabbed 82-year-old woman
stories.s: On Tuesday night, a man in his 50s or 60s entered a home in the 18700 block of 48th Ave W, searched it for cash, and assaulted and stabbed the 82-year-old resident. She is stable, and police released surveillance video.

stories.h: Air Force orders 15 more Everett-built KC-46A tankers
stories.s: Boeing received an Air Force contract for 15 additional KC-46A Pegasus tankers built at its Everett plant. That brings the total to 203 aircraft on contract or delivered worldwide. The article gives no contract value.

stories.h: Wave-powered AI data-center buoy arrives at Port of Everett
stories.s: A Panthalassa structure was towed through Puget Sound to Everett. My Everett News believes it is the startup's Ocean-3 unit, which pairs wave power with onboard computing and is headed for a Pacific test deployment.

coming.h: Edmonds tree lighting at Centennial Plaza
coming.s: The Edmonds Chamber of Commerce holds its annual tree lighting from 3 to 5 p.m. Saturday.

coming.h: Holiday Spark opens at Evergreen State Fair Park
coming.s: Free holiday festival in Monroe Dec. 3–6, running 5–8 p.m. on Thursday and Friday. Some activities cost extra, igloos can be reserved, and parking is $5.
